headline: See every cent _before_ you send it.
lede: Type an amount. You see what arrives, what it costs and when, with our rate set against the mid-market rate and a typical bank beside us.

compare.label: Typical bank
compare.source: Average published fee and exchange rate of five retail banks for a transfer from Germany to Vietnam.

arrival.where: in their bank account in Vietnam
arrival.note: Arrival assumes the payment clears our checks before the cut-off on a business day.

notes.title: Mid-market rate
notes.text: The midpoint between the buy and sell rates on global currency markets at the time shown. Our 0,45 % margin is built into the rate you get and is shown above as a cost in euros.

legal: Kittiwake Money GmbH is an authorised payment institution. Figures in this example are illustrative.
